crossRefs.note: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very…

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Hor_Mount

people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

translations.web: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
translations.bsb: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the outskirts of the land of Edom.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
